PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Names every block on a grid: faction tag, grid, short block name, direction
PluginData.Description:
Open the terminal: a Block Namer section sits at the bottom of every block's Control Panel.
Name Grid names every block, e.g. "[ACT] Hauler H2 Thr Fwd 2", "[ACT] Hauler Door Back Left", "[ACT] Hauler Bat 3". Thrusters get push direction; cameras, connectors and weapons get facing; doors, lights and vents get position; everything else is numbered. Numbers stay put as you build. Script tags like [IIM] and !LCD are kept.
Also: Preview Names, Renumber Grid, Create Groups, Auto-Name Grid, and tools for selected blocks (Set Name, Prefix, Suffix, Find and Replace, Add Numbers, Reset Name, Undo).
Chat: /bn, /bn preview, /bn renumber, /bn groups, /bn undo, /bn auto. Put #keep in a block name to skip it.
Client-side. Renames use the vanilla sync, so the server checks permissions as normal.
Bugs: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsBlockNamer/issues
